historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly flags state change and reboot but under-specifies both ports, recovery and secure access.

original_test_intent: Program the approved BlueField port link types in NIC NVRAM and prove after a full power cycle that every physical port enumerates and operates in its requested InfiniBand or Ethernet mode.
original_method: Map serial/BDF/MST device/P1/P2 to physical ports and management paths; query/save current mlxconfig; validate supported LINK_TYPE values; drain traffic and ensure OOB/recovery; approve and apply exact delta; read back; power-cycle; collect mlxconfig, ip link, ibstat and link health per port; rollback on mismatch.
manual_activity: Network owner approves exact per-port modes and maintenance; operator controls chassis power and recovery; agent may apply only the exact approved NVRAM delta and collect evidence.
required_inputs: Approved LINK_TYPE value per port and supported-mode specification
Current configuration backup and rollback command
Traffic drain, alternate OOB/console and power-cycle plan
safety_requirements: Never guess device or port ordering
Approve each NVRAM delta and power cycle separately
Maintain alternate access and stable power
Stop on readback, enumeration, link or recovery anomaly; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Query and apply exact mlxconfig delta
Collect readback and post-power-cycle per-port evidence
Stop and escalate before rollback/retry not explicitly approved

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: mlxconfig is correct but the example covers only P1, uses a guessed-style device variable and insecure remote access; it lacks query/readback and P2 verification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query the exact MST/BDF device, save full prestate, apply only approved LINK_TYPE_P1/P2 values, read back, then after operator power cycle collect full mlxconfig/ip link/ibstat per mapped port.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both P1/P2 link types, power-cycle activation, network-mode check and 20-minute allocations are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat link-type change as a versioned NVRAM transaction with stable port identity, before/after readback, controlled power activation and deterministic rollback.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target attestation, prestate backup, per-port verification, OOB/power gates and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful write message without power-cycle enumeration does not prove the requested modes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong target/mode can remove Ethernet/IB connectivity and management until another power cycle/rollback.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define numeric LINK_TYPE meanings for this firmware, whether both ports change together, expected netdev/IB device names and exact chassis power-cycle semantics.
expected_evidence: Full pre/post mlxconfig query and exact write output/status
Post-cycle ip link/ibstat/link health per port
Preserved logs, rollback outcome if used and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek retains the source's mlxconfig link-type and reboot intent; the deficiencies are target, port, evidence and recovery completeness.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if exact device/port mapping, supported values, prestate/rollback, OOB/power window or post-cycle verification cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row397 Wistron-Networking-00386-V003: approve BlueField serial/BDF/MST device→P1/P2 physical-port map, supported numeric LINK_TYPE values and desired mode per port, prestate backup/rollback, maintenance/OOB/power-cycle semantics and exact post-cycle mlxconfig/ip link/ibstat oracle.

review_improvement: Makes the persistent port-mode transition target-bound, reversible and verified at both NVRAM and operating-system layers.
independent_technical_reasoning: mlxconfig success only proves a write was accepted, not that the correct physical port will enumerate in the requested protocol after cold activation. P1/P2 identities and current values must be saved, and post-cycle Ethernet and IB views must independently confirm each port.
